scenarios.label: Normal operation
scenarios.summary: Healthy cooling plant on a normal day. Everything reads inside its learned range.
scenarios.world: Equipment and zone are steady. Weather is the live outside conditions when live weather is configured.
scenarios.expectation: No case should open. Use this first: the system learns what normal looks like.

scenarios.label: Emerging deterioration
scenarios.summary: Vibration and current creep upward while the zone warms slowly. Nothing changes suddenly.
scenarios.world: Over about 2.5 minutes the primary unit vibrates more and draws more current; the zone temperature drifts up. Simulated outdoor weather stays just below the heat limit.
scenarios.expectation: A single abnormal signal is only a watch; a case should open only if the combined condition persists.

scenarios.label: Compound cooling risk
scenarios.summary: Strong vibration and current anomalies on a very hot day while the zone warms.
scenarios.world: The primary cooling unit is mechanically degraded: high vibration, high current, a warming zone, and a simulated 108 F day.
scenarios.expectation: Several consecutive checks should confirm the pattern, open one case and send one alert.

scenarios.label: Ineffective mitigation
scenarios.summary: A person reports an action, but the primary unit stays degraded.
scenarios.world: The backup unit is running, but the primary unit's vibration and current stay abnormal.
scenarios.expectation: Reporting an action must not close the case: later sensor readings decide, and a follow-up is expected if they do not improve.

scenarios.label: Successful mitigation
scenarios.summary: The primary unit is repaired: vibration and current return to normal.
scenarios.world: Mechanical condition and current draw are back at their learned values; the zone cools. The hot day continues.
scenarios.expectation: After a reported action and enough trusted post-action readings, verification should be able to confirm the improvement.

scenarios.label: Sensor quality failure
scenarios.summary: The vibration gateway stops reporting and the meter sends old readings.
scenarios.world: Missing vibration data and ten-minute-old current readings from a degraded meter.
scenarios.expectation: Missing, stale or untrusted data must never read as healthy or as verified.

scenarios.label: Recurrence
scenarios.summary: After an improvement was verified, the same fault comes back.
scenarios.world: The original fault is reintroduced: strong vibration, high current, a warming zone, a hot day.
scenarios.expectation: If this happens while a verified improvement is still being watched, the same case should reopen.
